title: TransactionDeclined
description: This version governs a declined authorization call whose account identity the card cross-reference could not resolve. The authorization service publishes it: reject code 0100 records an attempt in unresolved_card_attempt, a decision in authorization_decision and one outbox row under this document, all in one local transaction, because AAP transformation rule T4 gives one authorization call one event. Reject reason 0100 at app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L385-L387 fires precisely when the keyed read of the cross-reference file misses, so no authoritative account identifier exists at that moment. Version 1 requires one, and supplying it would mean either trusting the identifier a caller sent beside the card number, which attributes one caller's declined attempt to another caller's account, or inventing an identifier inside the real account key space. This document therefore declares no accountId at all and keys the event on transactionId, a deterministic value that names no cardholder, no account and no card. Version 1 is unchanged and still governs reasons 0101, 0102 and 0103, so a consumer of resolved declines reads exactly the bytes it always read and a consumer that wants this decline opts in. Evolution is additive only, and it is bounded: additionalProperties is false and maxProperties is declared. An unknown top-level property is refused and a producer cannot hide a Primary Account Number, a card verification value or any other undeclared field inside a known event type. Additive evolution inside this version travels in the optional extensions object, whose property names, property count and value lengths are all bounded. Inside one version no field is removed, renamed, retyped or narrowed; a change of that kind takes a new schemaVersion and a new -v<n> document beside this one.
$comment: aggregateId is the Kafka message key and equals transactionId here, which the record enforces because JSON Schema cannot compare two properties. accountId is absent from properties, so additionalProperties false refuses it: a producer cannot smuggle a claimed account identifier into this contract. declineReasonCode and declineReasonDescription are both pinned to one value, because app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L370-L378 reads the account only while the reason code is still zero, so every reason other than 0100 has already resolved an account identifier and belongs to version 1.

eventId.description: The idempotency key, a lower-case canonical Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) of thirty-six characters. Each consumer records this identifier before it applies side effects. The pattern is asserted directly, so validation does not depend on the validator enabling the optional format-assertion vocabulary. Additive. No source field exists.

eventType.description: The routing discriminator. A consumer reads this field to learn which payload arrived. Additive. No source field exists.

schemaVersion.description: The contract version. This file is version 2, matching the -v2 suffix in its name. Version 2 is the contract for a decline carrying no account identifier. Additive. No source field exists.

occurredAt.description: The publish timestamp, in Coordinated Universal Time. The authorization service stamps it when it writes the event, and authorizedAt carries the time the authorization happened. Additive. No source field exists.

aggregateId.description: The Kafka message key, which under this version is the transaction identifier and not an account identifier. Width from TRAN-ID PIC X(16) at app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy:L5 and DALYTRAN-ID at app/cpy/CVTRA06Y.cpy:L5. The value equals transactionId, which the record enforces. Keying on it is deterministic, so a retried publish of the same decline lands on the same partition, and it discloses nothing: it names no cardholder, no account and no card. Sixteen characters cannot be mistaken for the eleven-digit account key every other contract uses.

transactionId.description: The transaction identifier, sixteen characters. From TRAN-ID PIC X(16) at app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy:L5 and DALYTRAN-ID at app/cpy/CVTRA06Y.cpy:L5.

declineReasonCode.description: The reject reason code, four digits zero-padded to the width the source writes. From WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON PIC 9(04) at app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L181. This version carries 0100 alone, set at app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L385, which is the one reason the source assigns before it has resolved an account identifier.

declineReasonDescription.description: The reject reason text that pairs with the code, reproduced character for character from app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L386. From WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC PIC X(76) at app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L182.

amount.description: The attempted amount as a decimal string with two fractional digits. From DALYTRAN-AMT PIC S9(09)V99 at app/cpy/CVTRA06Y.cpy:L10, so nine digits sit before the point. A leading minus is valid. 50 of the 300 records in app/data/ASCII/dailytran.txt hold a negative amount.
amount.$comment: app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L548-L551 adds a non-negative amount to the cycle credit accumulator and a negative amount to the cycle debit accumulator.

maskedCardNumber.description: The card number with twelve asterisks in place of the leading digits and the last four digits left visible. Position and width from DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM PIC X(16) at app/cpy/CVTRA06Y.cpy:L15. The masking is additive: no source program masks a Primary Account Number (PAN), and app/bms/COCRDSL.bms:L96-L99 defines the card detail field at the full sixteen characters. The authorization decision runs on the full PAN, and masking happens where the event is serialized. The cross-reference read at app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L382-L383 keys on all sixteen characters.

extensions.description: Optional, bounded room for additive evolution inside this version. A later producer puts a new value here and a consumer on this version still validates the event, which is what keeps a new consumer from breaking an existing one. The object is closed in every other direction: at most 16 members, each name a short identifier, each value a string of at most 256 characters, and no nested object or array. A field that belongs to the event contract is declared above instead; this object never carries a Primary Account Number, a card verification value or any other sensitive value. Additive. No source field exists.
